prompt:
Hey, I'm Jordan (ops manager at NovaSaaS). I have a backlog of 6 messages I need help handling — some internal, some client-facing, some investor-related. I've dropped my message requests in `comms/message_requests.json` and some of my recent messages in `comms/style_reference.txt` so you can get a sense of how I write.

Please go through each message request and figure out the best way to handle it: what channel to use, whether it's safe to draft and queue or whether it needs my eyes before anything goes out, timing considerations, and a suggested draft if appropriate.

Produce a single file called `message_plan.json` with your decisions and any draft text for each of the 6 messages.
